meta.name: organic-growth-advisor
meta.description: Identify which organic growth path to pursue — new segments, geographies, channels, or products. Use when diagnosing where a growth constraint lives and which McKinsey growth level to act on next.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断增长瓶颈并选择最佳增长路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在寻找新的市场、渠道或产品增长机会。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose growth constraints and choose the best growth path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are looking for new markets, channels, or product growth opportunities.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过三个问题诊断你的增长瓶颈，然后从四个增长路径（新客户群、新地域、新渠道、新产品）中推荐一个，并给出理由和下一步实验。
howto.when: 当你说出增长停滞、不确定选哪个增长方向，或需要快速决定增长实验的起点时触发。

say.text: 我们B2B薪资工具在美国中端市场增长停滞了，CEO想进欧洲，销售想要SMB层级。
say.note: Claude 会开始三问诊断，定位你的增长路径。

say.text: 帮我判断应该聚焦新客户群还是新地域。
say.note: Claude 会通过矩阵分析给出推荐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will diagnose your growth bottleneck through three questions, then recommend one of four growth paths (new customer segments, new geographies, new distribution channels, or new products) with rationale and a first experiment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention stalled growth, uncertainty about which growth direction to pursue, or need a quick decision on where to start a growth experiment.

say_en.text: Our B2B payroll tool is plateaued in US mid-market. CEO wants Europe, sales wants an SMB tier.
say_en.note: Claude will start the three-question triage to locate your growth path.

say_en.text: Help me decide whether to focus on new customer segments or new geographies.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze via the matrix and give a recommendation.
